definitions.explanation: a competition format where all teams or players compete against each other, with final standing determined by total wins and points

examples.japanese: リーグ{戦|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The league matches start next week.

examples.japanese: リーグ{戦|せん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{首位|しゅい}→首位：14677_shui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: We're in first place in the league.

examples.japanese: リーグ{戦|せん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦トーナメント→トーナメント：08408_toonamento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: After the league matches, a tournament will be held.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧ (league, from English) + ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (competition, match)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- リーグ{戦|せん} (round-robin format - all teams play each other)
- ⟦トーナメント→トーナメント：08408_toonamento⟧⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (knockout format - one loss eliminates)

ADVANTAGES:
In リーグ{戦|せん}, teams can lose some matches and still win overall, allowing for a fairer assessment of strength over time.

RELATED WORDS:
- {総当|そうあ}たり⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (round-robin tournament)
- ⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧ (league championship)
- ⟦{勝|か}ち{点|てん}→勝ち点：30390_kachiten⟧ (league points)
- ⟦{順位|じゅんい}→順位：14679_juni⟧ (ranking, standing)
